children: Specialty finance firm's Q3 net income and EPS fell sharply from prior year
Net interest income rose 5% yr/yr, but net interest margin narrowed
Company repurchased $5.6 mln in stock and announced new $40 mln buyback program
Company expects recently raised capital to support growth in consumer lending in coming quarters
Company authorized new $40 mln stock repurchase program to be executed opportunistically
Company expects gain from extinguishment of $15 mln trust preferred securities in Q4
CREDIT LOSS PROVISIONS - Co said higher upfront provisions for credit losses tied to loan growth reduced earnings in the quarter
LOAN ORIGINATION GROWTH - Co reported 41% yr/yr increase in total loan originations, led by 145% rise in home improvement loans
